summary: Destructor that frees three allocated sub-objects at this+0xC, this+0x1C and this+0x20, each null-guarded. The first two are freed through EmptyStub_7470 followed by FreeWrapper_7bcf (with an additional EmptyStub_0170 call before the first), and the third through ConditionalFreeOfField followed by FreeWrapper_7bcf. Called by F_3DSoundSourceDestructor (00545150), consistent with 3D sound source sub-object teardown.

local_names.this: object whose three sub-object pointers are released
local_names.v2: cached pointer read from this+0xC for the first free
local_names.v3: cached pointer read from this+0x1C for the second free
local_names.v4: cached pointer read from this+0x20 for the third free

operations.description: If the sub-object pointer at this+0xC is non-null, enter the first cleanup block
Invoke the EmptyStub_0170 cleanup stub with no arguments at the start of the first block
Re-read the first sub-object pointer into v2 and proceed only while it is non-null
Invoke EmptyStub_7470 with the first sub-object pointer (this+0xC) as its argument
Free the first sub-object via FreeWrapper_7bcf(v2)
If the second sub-object pointer at this+0x1C is non-null, free it
Invoke EmptyStub_7470 with the second sub-object pointer (this+0x1C) as its argument
Free the second sub-object via FreeWrapper_7bcf(v3)
If the third sub-object pointer at this+0x20 is non-null, free it
Invoke ConditionalFreeOfField on the third sub-object pointer (this+0x20)
Free the third sub-object via FreeWrapper_7bcf(v4)
Invoked by F_3DSoundSourceDestructor (00545150) as part of 3D sound source teardown

unresolved: The owner class is unknown; the 3D sound source attribution is inherited from the caller name and is not evidenced inside this function
The different teardown shape of the third block (ConditionalFreeOfField before free, no EmptyStub_7470) suggests the sub-objects belong to distinct types, but the types are not documented
Why the first block invokes EmptyStub_0170 while the others do not is not determinable
